title: Introductory Arm Drive Strength Primer Reset
summary: Upper Strength session focusing on upper body strength, posture, arm drive.
riskReason: Controlled movement patterns maintain safe tissue loading.

sessionStructure.name: Dumbbell Row
notes: Avoid rushing the return phase of the exercise.

sessionStructure.name: Incline Push-up
notes: Focus on perfect posture and form quality.

easierVariant.description: Reduce total exercise sets from 3 to 2 to manage local muscular fatigue.
modifications: Run only 2 sets per exercise.
Increase rest intervals between sets if needed.

harderVariant.description: Increase total sets from 3 to 4 or add minor load resistance.
modifications: Increase work volume by running 4 sets.
Maintain slower eccentric controls under loaded sets.

coachingNotes: Upper body strength supports running posture and efficient arm drive without adding excessive mass.
Focus on keeping the scapula retracting smoothly.
Complete all presses with complete control on the eccentric lowering phase.
commonMistakes: Rushing through the repetitions, which ruins correct movement form.
Holding your breath, which creates excessive thoracic pressure.
Neglecting proper joint alignment, placing shear load on knees or back.
safetyNotes: Listen to physical feedback; never push past sharp joint pain.
Ensure equipment is clean and weights are safely controlled.
Stop execution immediately if feeling dizzy or lightheaded.

title: Technical Arm Drive Power Builder Reset
summary: Upper Strength session focusing on upper body strength, posture, arm drive.
riskReason: Controlled movement patterns maintain safe tissue loading.

sessionStructure.name: Incline Push-up
notes: Avoid rushing the return phase of the exercise.

sessionStructure.name: Single-Arm Farmer's Carry
notes: Focus on perfect posture and form quality.

easierVariant.description: Reduce total exercise sets from 2 to 1 to manage local muscular fatigue.
modifications: Run only 1 sets per exercise.
Increase rest intervals between sets if needed.

harderVariant.description: Increase total sets from 2 to 3 or add minor load resistance.
modifications: Increase work volume by running 3 sets.
Maintain slower eccentric controls under loaded sets.

coachingNotes: Upper body strength supports running posture and efficient arm drive without adding excessive mass.
Focus on keeping the scapula retracting smoothly.
Complete all presses with complete control on the eccentric lowering phase.
commonMistakes: Rushing through the repetitions, which ruins correct movement form.
Holding your breath, which creates excessive thoracic pressure.
Neglecting proper joint alignment, placing shear load on knees or back.
safetyNotes: Listen to physical feedback; never push past sharp joint pain.
Ensure equipment is clean and weights are safely controlled.
Stop execution immediately if feeling dizzy or lightheaded.

title: Introductory B-Skip Coordination sequence Drill
summary: Running Drills session focusing on running form, coordination, efficiency.
riskReason: Controlled movement patterns maintain safe tissue loading.

sessionStructure.name: B-Skip
notes: Avoid rushing the return phase of the exercise.

sessionStructure.name: Butt Kicks
notes: Focus on perfect posture and form quality.

easierVariant.description: Reduce total exercise sets from 4 to 3 to manage local muscular fatigue.
modifications: Run only 3 sets per exercise.
Increase rest intervals between sets if needed.

harderVariant.description: Increase total sets from 4 to 5 or add minor load resistance.
modifications: Increase work volume by running 5 sets.
Maintain slower eccentric controls under loaded sets.

coachingNotes: Drills develop running coordination, posture, and foot strike efficiency.
Stay tall, high chest, with arms driving dynamically from the shoulder.
Focus on a high-cadence quick midfoot contact.
commonMistakes: Rushing through the repetitions, which ruins correct movement form.
Holding your breath, which creates excessive thoracic pressure.
Neglecting proper joint alignment, placing shear load on knees or back.
safetyNotes: Listen to physical feedback; never push past sharp joint pain.
Ensure equipment is clean and weights are safely controlled.
Stop execution immediately if feeling dizzy or lightheaded.

title: Mastery IT Band Support Routine Stiffness
summary: Injury Risk Reduction session focusing on tissue capacity, stability, muscle balance.
riskReason: Targeted eccentric loading builds localized tissue capacity safely.

sessionStructure.name: Side Plank with Leg Lift
notes: Avoid rushing the return phase of the exercise.

sessionStructure.name: Eccentric Heel Drop
notes: Focus on perfect posture and form quality.

easierVariant.description: Reduce total exercise sets from 3 to 2 to manage local muscular fatigue.
modifications: Run only 2 sets per exercise.
Increase rest intervals between sets if needed.

harderVariant.description: Increase total sets from 3 to 4 or add minor load resistance.
modifications: Increase work volume by running 4 sets.
Maintain slower eccentric controls under loaded sets.

coachingNotes: Tissue durability routines build localized capacity and tendon resilience.
Control calf drops slowly to protect the Achilles tendon.
Execute single-leg knee controls carefully to maintain proper hip alignment.
commonMistakes: Rushing through the repetitions, which ruins correct movement form.
Holding your breath, which creates excessive thoracic pressure.
Neglecting proper joint alignment, placing shear load on knees or back.
safetyNotes: Listen to physical feedback; never push past sharp joint pain.
Ensure equipment is clean and weights are safely controlled.
Stop execution immediately if feeling dizzy or lightheaded.
